name: Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN, 1994–1997)
description: A light-blue field charged at the centre with a yellow disc bearing six brown paddy stalks bound together.
history: Adopted at the ASEAN Ministerial Meeting in Bangkok on 23 July 1994, replacing the white flag; superseded at Kuala Lumpur on 31 May 1997 by the current flag with ten stalks for the enlarged membership.

features.symbolism: the five founding members and Brunei
